sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 251904, fetched 2026-10-20)

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/camel-lake-recreation-area ('RV hook-ups x 4(30/50 amps)') + RIDB catalog for 251904 (4 reservable RV ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Y), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 10 public sites (4 with 30/50-amp electric and water, 6 non-electric), all back-in, vehicle lengths 20-60 ft on recreation.gov; an eleventh site is the host's.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/camel-lake-recreation-area ('the well-shaded, 10-site campground, suitable for RVs or tents') + RIDB catalog for 251904 (10 reservable RV sites, Driveway Entry Back-in, Max Vehicle Length 20-60; one MANAGEMENT site), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251904 ('there is a bathhouse with flush toilets in the campsite and in the day-use area'; amenities 'Bath House', 'Flush Toilets', 'Outdoor Showers'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: recreation.gov rate table for 2026: non-electric RV site $20, electric $30. Day use $5 per vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251904/rates (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31: RV NONELECTRIC 20, RV ELECTRIC 30) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/camel-lake-recreation-area ('Camping Fees - Visit recreation.gov online for the most updated camping fees'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every site is reservable (no walk-in-only sites), up to the day of arrival; the Forest Service has made Camel Lake a recreation.gov 'Scan & Pay' site, so a site can also be reserved on a phone at the kiosk (cell service may be poor). 14 days within a rolling 30.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/251904 (notice 'There are no walk in only sites. All sites at this facility can be reserved'; reservationCutOff 0 days prior to arrival; maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 days rolling 30) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/florida/recreation/camel-lake-recreation-area ('THIS IS NOW A REC.GOV "SCAN & PAY" SITE'), read 2026-10-21

note: USFS drive-in campground south of Bristol; 10 sites (4 with electric) on ~20x45 ft aprons, suitable for tents or RVs; sandy swim beach at the day-use area.
summary: Confirmed on recreation.gov and the Forest Service page: 10 sites, 4 with 30/50-amp electric + water, all back-in to 60 ft, bathhouse with flush toilets and showers, $20 non-electric / $30 electric (2026), all sites reservable on recreation.gov (also Scan & Pay on site), 14-night limit. Note: '5 with electric' corrected to 4 (the fifth hookup is the host's site). Season: the FS page's 'Open year round' sits with the day-use hours, so season was left unset.
